title: Kenneth Arnold's paranormal experiences after his 1947 sighting

tellings.quote: I believe his daughter has now written a book talking about the mysterious paranormal experiences he had following his first sighting.

related.note: Concerns paranormal experiences Arnold had after his 1947 sighting, as told in his daughter's book, not the sighting itself; that makes it a distinct story from the Arnold sighting.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a guest with a doctorate speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about Kenneth Arnold, a man who reported seeing unidentified flying objects in the United States in 1947. Mishlove says he believes Arnold's daughter has written a book about mysterious paranormal experiences her father had after that first sighting, which would suggest such encounters reach beyond the sighting itself.
